flagged.title: Health, Fitness and Wellbeing
flagged.reason: The video states there are seven exact physical outcomes and 13 total examinable outcomes, omitting reduced risk of injury, which leaves students with missing spec outcomes and an incorrect figure.

mark_affecting.quote: OCR specifically expects you to know seven exact physical outcomes of regular activity... So, if we add all of that up, there are exactly 13 examinable outcomes.

flagged.title: Diet, Nutrition and Hydration
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that sprinters like Dina Asher-Smith use glycogen loading and that carbohydrates are the preferred fuel regardless of exercise intensity, both of which would lose marks in an OCR GCSE PE exam.

mark_affecting.quote: Elite distance runners, cyclists, and sprinters like Dina Asher-Smith use something called glycogen loading.
Carbohydrates are your body's absolute preferred primary go-to fuel, regardless of the intensity.
